newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian govt to pass new data to Duma soon.
newsitem.headline: Russian govt to pass new data to Duma soon.

text.p: The Russian government will send a package of documents on the country's economic situation to the State Duma lower house of parliament on June 4, a government spokesman said on Tuesday.
"A new package of documents of analytical character is ready and will be presented to the Duma by the start of its plenary session," Igor Shabdurasulov told a news conference.
The next Duma sitting will take place on June 4.

Last week the Duma, after postponing a vote on budget spending cuts, or sequestration, asked the government to submit proposals on increasing budget revenues and revised figures for Russia's social and economic development based on the first quarter figures.
Shabdurasulov said the government's views on the state of the economy and need to sequester spending had not changed.
